title: Pascal-crossing twins: a level-stripping accelerator jumps to the right-end events
text: The ladder of levels is now arithmetic: a mixed-radix counter, and an eater's K super-cycles jumped at once with a closed form proved in Lean for every K. For 1RB1LF_1LC1RB_1LE1LD_1LB0RD_1LF---_1LA0LA it goes from wall visit 10<sup>1600</sup> to the seventh event in 9 s, at exactly the visit found before. For 1RB1LF_1LC1RB_1LF1LD_1LE0RD_1LB---_1LA0LA it shows that the next event, and so any halt, cannot come before wall visit 256<sup>2.394·10<sup>146</sup></sup> (before: 10<sup>25600</sup>).
